job_description:
**Position Overview**
• *Location** : Missoula, MT (Non-Exempt)
• *Experience Level** : 0-1 Years
• *Employment Type** : Full-Time
• *About Cognizant's CX CRM Moment Practice:**
At Cognizant CX/CRM Moment Practice, small cross-functional teams comprised of Product Managers, Architects, Developers, Designers, and Analysts build high-quality software faster than siloed individuals working independently. These nimble teams foster empathy and collaboration, enabling them to adapt quickly to changing requirements and deliver innovative cloud-based solutions. Our teams follow a Lean-Agile process with a DevOps culture, pushing digital boundaries and embracing transformational technologies in the Customer Experience and CRM areas.
• *The Role:**
Cognizant is seeking a motivated and innovative **MuleSoft Jr. Developer** to join our team. This role will focus on building intelligent, scalable contact center solutions using MuleSoft Anypoint platform. The ideal candidate is a collaborative engineer with a passion for cloud-native development, AI integration, and customer experience transformation.
Cognizant is seeking an energetic, curious, and technology‑driven **Gen C / college graduates** to join our **MuleSoft Integration Engineering team** . **MuleSoft Jr. Developer** will be trained and mentored to build modern API‑led connectivity solutions that power digital transformation for global enterprises. Trained associates will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing team that designs, develops, and delivers integration solutions using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, while also learning how AI‑powered tools, accelerators, and automation enhance API development, testing, monitoring, and integration lifecycle productivity.
• *Responsibilities:**
· Learn and apply API‑led design principles to build integrations using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
· Develop, test, and deploy APIs, integrations, and microservices under guidance from senior developers and architects.
· Learn to leverage AI‑powered MuleSoft developer tools such as Anypoint Code Builder, which provides intelligent code suggestions, flow generation, RAML generation, DataWeave script creation, and automated error correction.
· Assist in building AI‑augmented integration flows using generative flows, AI‑powered RAML generation, intelligent mapping, SQL generation, and automated documentation. Work with connectors, DataWeave transformations, RAML/OAS API specs.
· Troubleshoot and debug issues during development and deployment cycles.
· Follow best practices, coding standards, and documentation guidelines defined by the practice.
· Collaborate with Agile teams participating in standups, sprint planning, and reviews.
· Continuously upskill through internal bootcamps, training programs, and certification tracks supported by the MuleSoft CoE.
• *Pre-Requisites / Qualification:**
· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or equivalent.
· Strong proficiency in core programming with Java, C++, Python, JavaScript, and other similar languages.
· Good knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML and JMS messaging
· Good grasp of data structures, algorithms, and problem‑solving fundamentals.
· Spring, Maven, and related frameworks and technology!
· Understanding of databases (SQL/NoSQL) and cloud fundamentals
· Understanding of Git, CI/CD, SDLC, and integration patterns.
· Eagerness to learn integration technologies, cloud platforms, APIs, and MuleSoft ecosystem.
· Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
• *Preferred Qualifications:**
· Exposure to integration, API, MuleSoft, or microservices concepts through coursework, projects, or internships.
· Familiarity with DevOps concepts, Git, CI/CD pipelines, or monitoring tools.
· Interest in AI‑assisted development, automation tools, or using AI to improve software productivity.
· Passion for building scalable, reusable, and high‑quality software components.
• *Start Date**
New hires will start in **June 2026** in our Cognizant **Missoula, MT** office. While we will attempt to honor candidate start date preferences, business need and position availability will determine final start date assignment. Exact start date will be communicated with enough time for you to plan effectively.
• *Salary and Other Compensation:**
The annual salary for this position is $65,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant's discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant's applicable plans.
• *Why Choose Us?**
Cognizant delivers solutions that draw upon the full power and scale of our associates. You will be supported by high-caliber experts and employ some of the most advanced and patented capabilities. Our associate's diverse backgrounds offer multifaceted perspectives and fuel new ways of thinking. We encourage lively discussions which inspire better results for our clients.
• *Benefits**
Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:
· Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
· Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
· 401(k) plan and contributions
· Long-term/Short-term Disability
· Paid Parental Leave
· Employee Stock Purchase Plan
• *Disclaimer**
The hourly rate, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.
• *Work Authorization**
Due to the nature of this position, Cognizant cannot provide sponsorship for U.S. work authorization (including participation in a CPT/OPT program) for this role.
_Cognizant is always looking for top talent. We are searching for candidates to fill future needs within the business. This job posting represents potential future employment opportunities with Cognizant. Although the position is not currently available, we want to provide you with the opportunity to express your interest in future employment opportunities with Cognizant. If a job opportunity that you may be qualified for becomes available in the future, we will notify you. At that time you can determine whether you would like to apply for the specific open position. Thank you for your interest in Cognizant career opportunities._
Cognizant is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
